title: Local points on twists of $X(p)$ with applications: two-dimensional mod p representations with equal determinants and equal inertia restrictions are isomorphic
author: Nuno Freitas, Diana Mocanu
work: Local points on twists of $X(p)$ with applications
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's Lemma (source0.tex lines 2411--2423, source label lem:niveau-two-representations): for a prime greater than two, two continuous two-dimensional mod p representations of the absolute Galois group of the p-adic field with equal determinants and inertia restrictions isomorphic to a non-degenerate pair of niveau two characters are isomorphic; delivered with the article's complete original proof at source0.tex lines 2425--2484 (one adjacent proof environment of 60 lines that opens and closes inside the retained span). The proof is complete and closed inside the retained span and uses nothing outside the statement: it extends scalars to the quadratic unramified field, chooses a basis in which the inertia action is diagonal with the two prescribed characters, writes the two representations in that basis, uses the equality of determinants and the non-degeneracy of the pair of characters to show that the off-diagonal entries are forced, and then rescales the basis to make the two matrices equal, producing an explicit isomorphism over the prime field. This rigidity lemma is the technical input that lets the article control the local behaviour of the twisted representations it studies. H2: a research-level arithmetic-geometry lemma whose proof combines the structure of two-dimensional mod p Galois representations, the classification of their inertia action through niveau two characters, determinant comparisons and an explicit change of basis; it is well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.
